name: hud_ui_zrd_widget_ex17c_item_hide_preview_if_not_selected
description: HudUiZrdWidgetEx17C_Item::HidePreviewIfNotSelected forwards to the base preview reset helper only when the item is not selected.
known_limits: Tier C only; tier S byte comparison is deferred to a coherent HudUiZrdWidgetEx17C item/table pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4b87e0 validates the selected flag read at offset 0x14c, early return when selected is nonzero, and tailcall to HudUiZrdWidget::HidePreview when selected is zero.
The native smoke verifies the unselected path restores the default image and the selected path leaves the current image unchanged.
